version.changelog:
Chatterbox Turbo TTS and backend integration:

- Added support for the CUDA-only "Chatterbox Turbo" TTS engine, offering English synthesis, 19 inline emotion tags, and transcript-free voice cloning.
- Updated documentation and endpoints to reflect 3 TTS engines / 4 backends.
- Listed new usage scenarios for Chatterbox Turbo, including emotive delivery with inline tags and cloning without needing transcripts.
- Clarified engine limitations and compatibility in "When To Use" and "When NOT To Use" sections.
- Removed legacy or obsolete documentation (skill-card.md).

llm.summary: The skill is a clearly documented self-hosted speech service integration, with meaningful but disclosed risks around network exposure, staged audio storage, URL fetching, and voice cloning.

dimensions.detail: The service can bind broadly, fetch URLs server-side, and cache files persistently; the artifact repeatedly documents these risks and gives controls such as loopback binding, bearer auth, HTTPS, and TALKIES_BLOCK_PRIVATE_DOWNLOADS.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup uses Docker images and local curl/ffmpeg/docker examples, plus an executable bulk_transcribe.sh helper; these are disclosed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are explicit about sending audio/text to TALKIES_URL, using only configured endpoints, cleaning up staged files, enabling auth, and obtaining consent for voice cloning.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Staged uploads, downloaded URLs, custom voices, and model files persist under the server data directory until explicit cleanup, but this persistence is central to the service and clearly disclosed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The capabilities match the stated purpose: ASR, TTS, streaming transcription, server-side file staging, MCP ASR tools, Docker setup, and a bulk transcription helper.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only against a Talkies server you operate or trust. Enable TALKIES_AUTH_TOKEN before exposing it beyond localhost, prefer loopback or TLS-proxied access, turn on private-address URL blocking for untrusted clients, avoid staging sensitive media unless access is controlled, clean up staged files after use, and only use voice cloning with explicit speaker consent.
